note: S1w + E2. S1w: in the o_proj columns of nine full-attention copy heads (23.h5, 23.h4, 23.h0, 23.h1, 15.h7, 15.h6, 19.h5, 19.h0, 19.h2) the output component in the span of the readout rows of thirteen line-start words (Wait, So, Maybe, This, Let, But, Is, No, If, Okay, What, Yes, Then; with and without leading space) is inverted (orthonormal projector, rank 26), so that a word that has started many lines is inhibited instead of copied; this includes and replaces R1 (the Wait component is inverted exactly). E2: one neuron of the last MLP (layer 23, neuron 1998) replaced by a stop detector: gate = c - 25 o, up = c - 23 o, down = b2 v (c: difference of means between line ends that state the answer and all other positions, unit length; o: closed-form near-constant reference direction; v: readout row of </think> made orthogonal to its 12 nearest token rows). Raises the </think> logit only at line ends that conclude a result.
